decisions.reason: It appears closer to the firm's industrial metalworking base and survived the first review cycle into 2019, so with low catalog-maintenance cost the option value of keeping it remains fairly high.

As a 2019 launch in a related metal-fabrication category, it is plausible to keep it available one year longer because carrying it is likely cheap, but by 2022 the firm should be close to deciding based on whether demand has materialized.
This variant offers a somewhat clearer use case than a basic bin or a standalone ashtray, so the firm has reason to keep the option open if municipal or commercial orders are still uncertain.

The standalone outdoor ashtray looks like the narrowest and most easily substituted option in the 2019 street-furniture group, so once uncertainty has largely resolved it is the most likely candidate for abandonment.
